description: Either NAND or NOR alone represents every truth function with at least one input, without constants or additional inputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.single_gate_constant_free_complete
  (k : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateKind) (n : ℕ) (h : 0 < n)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.TruthFunction n) :
  ∃ A,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.GateNoConstants A ∧
      ∀ (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation (Fin n)),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.gateEval k v A = f v
